notes: Reconciliation-only. Executed by src/validate_coupon_performance.py, which independently recomputes every coupon_code's redemption-funnel counts in pandas (never importing src/etl_spark_coupon_performance.py's Spark logic) and compares against the curated table it wrote.

The 5 *_reconciliation rules below check the CATALOG-WIDE total (summed across all coupon_codes) -- coupon_performance_row_counts_match_per_code is the stronger check that every individual code's row (counts AND redemption_rate) matches exactly, not just the totals.

rules.description: Total coupon_rule_count across all curated coupon_performance rows must match the number of distinct coupon_rule_id records in raw coupon_rules.
Total currently_valid_rule_count across all curated coupon_performance rows must match the count of raw coupon_rules whose [valid_from, valid_to] window contains as_of_date.
Total offers_created across all curated coupon_performance rows must match the count of raw prequal_offers with a non-null coupon_code created on or before as_of_date.
Total applications_submitted across all curated coupon_performance rows must match the count of raw applications whose originating offer used a coupon_code.
Total loans_funded across all curated coupon_performance rows must match the count of raw loans whose originating application's offer used a coupon_code.

Every individual coupon_code's row (coupon_rule_count, currently_valid_rule_count, offers_created, applications_submitted, loans_funded, and redemption_rate) must match an independent per-code pandas recomputation, not just the catalog-wide totals -- redemption_rate is checked separately from the counts because a bug in the rate formula itself would not show up in the count-only checks.
